🚨 HMPV Detected in India!

Two cases of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) found in Karnataka, but no unusual surge in respiratory illnesses, assures the Centre. 

The virus is already circulating globally 🌍

Stay informed and stay safe! 🦠
